_about: One source for the credits and the game's descriptions. 'tagline' (one line) is read by tools/web_postexport.py (play page meta description, manifest, <noscript>) and written into game/project.godot (config/description) by tools/sync_site.py. 'description' (a few sentences) is written by tools/sync_site.py into the landing page's meta description, link preview (og:description) and hero paragraph, and the summary line of site/llms.txt. The game reads the credits (title screen, journal links); tools/sync_site.py also writes the support block on the landing page. Edit here, then run python3 tools/sync_site.py. See CLAUDE.md, 'One source'.
name: Sinoi the Fisherman
tagline: An active, touch-first pixel-art fishing game set in the world of #HusbandOutWorld.
description: An active, touch-first pixel-art fishing game set in the world of the #HusbandOutWorld series. Fight every fish with taps, slides, flicks and two-finger moves. Free, no ads, no in-app purchases, and open source.
support_text: Brought to you by Deovandski, author of the #HusbandOutWorld series and CEO/Founder of Wizard Deo Solutions. Have fun! If you want to support me, buy the eBooks on Amazon, or host a West March D&D campaign using the World Lore.
